source_review: In the unchanged HBase 2.6.6 TestRegionMove.testDisableAndMove JUnit, both move calls intentionally throw B2 DoNotRetryRegionException. For the response-loss candidate, the first UnassignRegion RPC reached AssignmentManager with an OPEN region and no procedure, completed CloseRegionProcedure and UNASSIGN TransitRegionStateProcedure, and persisted CLOSED in hbase:meta before the successful RPC response was replaced by a SocketTimeoutException. HBaseAdmin rebuilt the same region-only UnassignRegion request in RpcRetryingCallerImpl; Master.proto has no operation nonce. The retry reached B2 with CLOSED and no procedure, so the server correctly rejected a duplicate unassign and the original JUnit failed at admin.unassign. Two clean exact-selector replays (49.18 s and 46.41 s) reproduced this ordering and JUnit found=1 succeeded=0 failed=1; an assign-response replay (50.19 s) showed symmetric OPEN after completed assign. Admin.assign/unassign Javadocs explicitly allow IOException for remote or network exceptions. A lost response therefore leaves client completion ambiguous, and no stronger contract violation or internal invariant breach is established. The client-level observation remains candidate_unconfirmed, not a confirmed new bug.

observed_sequence: First UnassignRegion request reaches AssignmentManager.preTransitCheck with region OPEN and no active procedure; it returns normally.
CloseRegionProcedure and TransitRegionStateProcedure UNASSIGN both finish SUCCESS, and RegionStateStore writes CLOSED to hbase:meta.
The client-side response hook substitutes SocketTimeoutException after the RPC returned normally; no request-side or server-side exception is injected.
HBaseAdmin retries UnassignRegion for the same region; AssignmentManager.preTransitCheck now sees CLOSED with no active procedure and throws DoNotRetryRegionException.

The exception propagates through MasterRpcServices, MasterCallable, RpcRetryingCallerImpl, and HBaseAdmin.unassign to the original JUnit at TestRegionMove.java:105, which fails before its expected move checks.
client_level_candidate.source_review: HBaseAdmin.assign/unassign rebuild the same region-only request inside an executeCallable retry. MasterRpcServices delegates to synchronous AssignmentManager assign/unassign. The Master.proto request has no operation nonce. RpcRetryingCallerImpl retries the synthetic response timeout, then fails fast on the server's DoNotRetryIOException subclass. The server guard correctly rejects a duplicate transition; the potentially misleading client result is the candidate.
